briefdescription.para: Downsampling: groups points into buckets of resolution_ns width.
TSCH-01: Monotonic timestamps are accepted without error.
TSCH-02: Out-of-order timestamp raises TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_ORDER.
TSCH-03: Zero (null) timestamp raises TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_ORDER.
TSCH-04: Duplicate timestamp (== tail) raises TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_ORDER.
TSCH-05: Range query [start, end] returns all points with ts in range.
TSCH-06: Empty range (no points in [start, end]) → empty result, no error.
TSCH-07: Non-existent series → SERIES_NOT_FOUND.
TSCH-08: Points at exact start and end boundaries are included.
TSCH-09: Gorilla round-trip preserves arbitrary IEEE 754 float64.
TSCH-10: NaN is preserved through Gorilla encode/decode (bit-identical).
TSCH-11: +Inf is preserved through Gorilla encode/decode.
TSCH-12: -Inf is preserved through Gorilla encode/decode.
TSCH-13: Output bucket count is deterministic for given resolution.
TSCH-14: Empty input → empty output.
TSCH-15: Single point passes through unchanged as single bucket.
TSCH-16: Zero resolution → DOWNSAMPLING_RESOLUTION_INVALID.

xrefdescription.para: TEH-01: Empty endpoint URL returns REMOTE_WRITE_VALIDATION_ERROR.
TEH-02: Non-http/https URL returns REMOTE_WRITE_VALIDATION_ERROR.
TEH-03: Valid https URL returns success (nullopt).
TEH-04: URL exceeding kMaxEndpointLength returns REMOTE_WRITE_VALIDATION_ERROR.
TEH-05: Timeout handler returns REMOTE_WRITE_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED.
TEH-06: Each timeout call increments the timeout counter.
TEH-07: Incident callback is invoked on remote-write timeout.
TEH-08: URL containing control characters returns REMOTE_WRITE_VALIDATION_ERROR.
TEH-09: Null key pointer returns ENCRYPTION_STATE_INVALID.
TEH-10: Zero-length key returns ENCRYPTION_STATE_INVALID.
TEH-11: Invalid key length (e.g. 20 bytes) returns ENCRYPTION_STATE_INVALID.
TEH-12: Valid AES key lengths (16/24/32) return success (nullopt).
TEH-13: Rotation with invalid new key returns ENCRYPTION_KEY_NOT_FOUND.
TEH-14: Rotation with valid 32-byte key returns success and increments counter.
TEH-15: Incident callback is invoked on successful key rotation.
TEH-16: Multiple successful rotations increment counter correctly.
TEH-17: Buffer below kMaxOutOfOrderBuffer does not require flush.
TEH-18: Buffer at kMaxOutOfOrderBuffer triggers flush requirement.
TEH-19: TsOperatorDiagnostics records incident with correct severity.
TEH-20: formatSummary includes incident ID and severity.
